top_signals.title: Gold Holds Decline as Strong US Data Raises Fed Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Gold held a decline as stronger-than-expected US economic data increased bets the Federal Reserve might again raise interest rates to combat inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: European Gas Advances as US-Iran Tensions Cloud Supply Outlook
top_signals.summary: European natural gas rose after Iran’s president highlighted the wide gap between Tehran and Washington as the war drags on, dimming hopes that energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz will normalize any time soon.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Turkey to Discuss Investor Paybacks in Two-Day Fund Crisis Talks
top_signals.summary: Turkey’s economic authorities will hold two days of talks on how to repay investors in 131 investment funds being liquidated after a wave of redemption failures triggered turmoil in the country’s markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: China-US Trade Truce Extended As Xi Arrives
top_signals.summary: United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced the US and China have sealed a two-month extension to their trade truce, as Xi Jinping landed in America for his first state visit in eleven years. Stephen Engle reports from Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Deadly impacts of Typhoon Dujuan highlight toll of repeated rain disasters
top_signals.summary: Some residents are struggling to deal with flooding for the second time in weeks, after heavy rain that caused damage and disruption just last month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
